id: title:fuziontech:retry the duckgres idle session reap in the events backfill

review.posthog_relevance: DuckDB backfill DAG connection failure handling
review.reason: Adds psycopg.errors.IdleSessionTimeout and related idle timeout messages to the set of exceptions treated as connection drops. This prevents misclassification of idle-session-timeout errors as transient transport or SQL errors, which could have caused unnecessary retries and double-application of statements in the DuckDB backfill DAG. review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that idle-session-timeout errors were previously misclassified and caused issues, which is not independently verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are used; no score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds psycopg.errors.IdleSessionTimeout and psycopg.OperationalError with 'terminating connection due to idle timeout' to the set of exceptions treated as connection drops, alongside the existing transport and SQL-state markers.
observations.posthog_connection: This expands the classification of connection failures in the DuckDB backfill DAG. Previously, an idle-session-timeout error could have been misclassified as a transient transport or SQL error, potentially triggering a retry and risking double-application of a statement.
